**[P2] Preserve Java types passed to content transforms**

`deepCopyContent` normalizes typed values before invoking the transform—for example, a DTO becomes a `LinkedHashMap` and an `Instant` becomes a string. A transform that casts the documented execution input/output to its Java type therefore throws, and this catch silently omits the field. Keep a type-preserving defensive snapshot for transform invocation, then detach/normalize the transform result for export; test DTO and Java-time transforms.
